Stars describe a repository at the time of the snapshot; they do not rank individual templates or prove click-through performance.

directions.name: 照片分栏 · 专题报道
directions.description: 文字与主图分区，适合人物报道、商业观察和生活专题
directions.selection_reason: Explicit text/image zoning; different from full-scene lifestyle photography.

directions.name: 人物切片 · 对谈封面
directions.description: 主体越过色块边界，适合访谈、创作者故事与人物观点
directions.sourceLabel: Nano Banana Pro · 案例参考
directions.selection_reason: Subject crosses a color boundary; different from the painted human-narrative style.

directions.name: 黑白影像 · 城市留白
directions.description: 黑白环境与克制标题，适合城市、建筑与独处主题
directions.sampleTitle: 城市很大，也需要自己的角落
directions.selection_reason: Photographic black-and-white environmental framing; different from engraving linework.

directions.name: 胶片拼版 · 旅行手记
directions.description: 两到三幅关联场景形成节奏，适合旅行、观察与回顾
directions.sampleTitle: 带着好奇心，去一座陌生的城市
directions.selection_reason: A related scene sequence; different from an argument made with cutout fragments.

directions.name: 撕纸日记 · 生活拼贴
directions.description: 纸边、照片与少量笔触，适合生活记录和个人成长
directions.sampleTitle: 把零碎日常，拼成自己的生活
directions.selection_reason: Personal paper-layer record; different from the archive-card style and polemical collage.

directions.name: 包豪斯 · 形状与秩序
directions.description: 几何形体有节奏地呼应标题，适合设计、创意和方法主题
directions.selection_reason: Meaningful geometric balance; different from a purely alignment-driven Swiss layout.

directions.name: 粗野排版 · 街头观点
directions.description: 巨大文字和粗粝印刷感，适合鲜明立场与行动宣言
directions.selection_reason: Deliberately raw monumental typography; different from the warm flat magazine headline.

directions.name: 复古旅行 · 风景明信片
directions.description: 分层风景与暖色印刷，适合旅行、地方记录和周末生活
directions.selection_reason: Layered lithographic landscape; different from cinematic photorealism and literary painting.

directions.name: 蓝晒印相 · 自然观察
directions.description: 植物或物件的光影轮廓，适合自然、科学观察和慢生活
directions.sampleTitle: 观察一片叶子，重新认识自然
directions.selection_reason: Original contact-print material direction extending subject/whitespace research; not a copied science-poster case.

directions.name: 水墨叠影 · 人文意象
directions.description: 主体轮廓与山水空间相融，适合人文、阅读和文化随笔
directions.sampleTitle: 山水之间，看见另一种生活
directions.selection_reason: Silhouette and environment merge; different from the body-only traditional ink landscape recipe.

directions.name: 微缩场景 · 故事切片
directions.description: 一个立体空间承载故事，适合书评、场所与创作主题
directions.sourceLabel: Nano Banana Pro · 案例参考
directions.sampleTitle: 小小书店，装得下一个世界
directions.selection_reason: One narrative diorama; different from process/exploded scientific diagrams.

directions.name: 雾面渐变 · 科技专题
directions.description: 柔和光场与清晰大字，适合 AI、数字产品和未来讨论
directions.sampleTitle: 工具在变，创造力走向哪里
directions.selection_reason: Matte light field around a typographic headline; different from the neon local-card layout.

directions.name: 动势瞬间 · 行动主题
directions.description: 斜向力量和人物动作，适合行动、习惯、运动与挑战
directions.sampleTitle: 迈出第一步，比准备更重要
directions.selection_reason: Physical gesture and directional force; different from a static character scene.

directions.name: 展览图录 · 艺术阅读
directions.description: 作品、留白与严谨字距，适合艺术、审美和文化评论
directions.sampleTitle: 换个角度，重新看一件作品
directions.selection_reason: Original object viewed as an artwork with catalog spacing; different from commercial still-life photography.
